# Reflection

This portfolio reflects my transition from a consulting and project management background into a more analytics-focused role.  

It demonstrates not only the development of technical skills, but also my ability to apply data-driven thinking to real business problems.


<div class="cards-container">

<div class="card">

## Learning Journey

Throughout this module, I developed practical skills in:

- Python for data analysis  
- exploratory data analysis and statistical thinking  
- machine learning fundamentals  

More importantly, I learned how to **connect technical analysis with business context**

- In the fraud detection project, I explored how data can support risk identification and decision-making  
- In the NLP project, I worked with unstructured text data and compared AI approaches, gaining insight into model strengths and limitations  

This shift from *technical execution* to *business-oriented analysis* was a key part of my development.

This transition required a shift in mindset, from focusing on delivery and execution to thinking critically about data, interpretation, and decision-making.

</div>

<div class="card">

## Challenges and Problem Solving

One of the main challenges was working with machine learning models such as BERT.

- Initially, I found it difficult to understand how text is processed and how models can be applied in practice  
- I addressed this by breaking down the workflow step-by-step and focusing on core concepts rather than complexity  

Another challenge was handling performance and technical constraints when working with large models.

- I simplified the implementation  
- Reduced dataset size where necessary  
- Focused on meaningful outputs rather than computational complexity  

I also faced challenges in building the portfolio using Quarto.

- Learning how to structure files, manage YAML configuration, and debug rendering issues was an important part of the process  

These challenges helped me become more confident in both technical implementation and problem-solving.

Before this module, I viewed analytics mainly as reporting and data processing. This experience changed my perspective, showing that analytics is fundamentally about interpreting data to support decisions.

</div>

<div class="card">

## Key Insights

This experience highlighted several important lessons:

- Technical accuracy alone is not enough — **clear communication of results is equally important**  
- Simpler, well-structured models can often be more effective than complex approaches  
- Understanding the business problem is critical when selecting analytical methods  
- Model performance must always be interpreted in context, not just reported  
- My consulting background helped me approach analytics problems in a structured and business-oriented way  

</div>

<div class="card">

## Future Development

Going forward, I plan to strengthen my skills in:

- advanced machine learning techniques  
- feature engineering and model evaluation  
- data visualisation and dashboard development  
- applying analytics to real-world business problems  

While I have built a strong foundation, I recognise that further experience is needed to apply advanced models at scale and in real-world production environments.

This portfolio represents an important step in developing a strong foundation for a career in data analytics.

</div>
